scope: Read-only statistical and chronology review of non-dispatch design. No methodological truth, powered-study qualification or clinical activation certified.

resolved_findings.issue: Zero complete packages and partial packages could trigger overlapping stop/revise dispositions.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final protocol states stop > revise > route_exists_only; zero joint_ready stops even when partial packages exist.

remaining_limitations: Exact request bytes, dates, response guards and exposure inventory remain unresolved technical dispatch blockers; design acceptance is not acquisition qualification.
No clinical event/prevalence estimate, attained power, fitted scorer, causal efficacy reference, representative clinical evaluation or H1/H2 result established.
Reporting allowance, claim-specific endpoint bridge, Brier success criterion, sidedness, multiplicity and actual dependence-valid analysis require qualification before launch.
Agent source extraction is documentary reproducibility; agreement does not establish independent therapeutic truth.
